title: Brent over-extension momentum control
hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Reversal control: Brent price over-extension (20d z-score of BZ=F close > 1) is momentum not mean-reversion: Brent log return continues higher over the next 3 days (+); trade long BZ=F 3d [finance.BZ=F.close -> finance.BZ=F.log_return] (parent: R2-0018)
message: Weak momentum: z>1 long BZ=F 1d gives 52% hit, +0.16%/trade excess in-sample but -0.08% OOS in war window; lag-0 r=1.0 is a level-vs-return artifact, not evidence. actionability 3.15

trade_idea.entry_rule: finance.BZ=F.close rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long BZ=F next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Mean-reversion side of R2-0116: Brent over-extension (20d z-score of BZ=F close > 1) fades, so Brent log return is lower over the next 5 days (-); trade short BZ=F 5d [finance.BZ=F.close -> finance.BZ=F.log_return] (parent: R2-0116)
